aiSummary: In October 2026, Safari iPhone led browser versions (mobile) in North America at 44.17% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome for Android ranked second at 43.08%, followed by Chrome for iPhone at 6.49%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (mobile) in North America?
faqs.answer: Safari iPhone leads at 44.17% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/mobile/north-america.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (mobile) in North America?
faqs.answer: Safari iPhone (44.17%), Chrome for Android (43.08%), Chrome for iPhone (6.49%) in October 2026.
